note: Strategies of the Boss boards (spec: documentation/mecaniques/strategies.md). A strategy has a kind: parametric (the engine routine that buys servants, levels and equipment, tuned by want, level, equipP, score and target), board (the board is the plan of the room: rooms and growth) or random (built into the engine: any legal move). "default" is used by a dungeon that names none: a name, { use, override } or { pool: [names] } (drawn without repeating from board to board). Names and descriptions: texts behavior.<id> and behavior.<id>.desc. Behaviors of the Boss's boards (each game draws different ones, one per board). want: number of servants aimed for at a room, min(maxBoard, base + floor(room / per)); level: reinforcement level aimed for, base + floor(room / per); equipP: probability of buying an equipment rather than a servant once the board is full; score: how an offered card is valued (card = the engine's card score, rank = rank first, sharedTypes = card score + types shared with the board); target: which servant receives an equipment (strongest, leastEquipped, fixed = the mini-boss). Names and descriptions: texts behavior.<id> and behavior.<id>.desc.
